titolo: alesha-pro/llm.asm: Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT tr
descr: Alesha‑pro released three x86‑64 NASM‑only projects, including a 14 KB Qwen3‑0.6B inference binary and a bootable OS.
paragrafi: The GitHub repo llm.asm by alesha‑pro contains three complete LLM projects written entirely in x86‑64 NASM assembly, with no C, C++, Rust, or libc dependencies.

The first project, 01‑qwen3‑inference, compiles a 14,712‑byte static ELF that runs Qwen3‑0.6B (Q8_0) inference, achieving 126.8 tokens per second on a 40‑thread AMD EPYC 7642 and matching PyTorch FP32 output.

The second project, 02‑baremetal‑os, builds a 24,252‑byte bootable OS that loads the same model directly on hardware, booting in 74–94 ms and delivering up to 134.9 tokens per second on KVM‑emulated EPYC hardware.
The third project, 03‑minigpt‑train, provides a from‑scratch Mini‑GPT trainer of 32,944 bytes, training TinyShakespeare to a validation loss of 1.51 in four minutes.
perche: These ultra‑compact binaries enable running modern LLM inference on minimal resources, appealing to developers who need local, dependency‑free AI without a full OS. For the free‑model community, the projects illustrate that high‑quality inference can be achieved with tiny footprints, expanding options for edge and research deployments.
